decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost pricing tier of the established anamnesis app that serves large practices, so it fits the firm's paperless strategy, costs little to carry given its slack and installed base, and gives no sign of falling short of aspirations.

Support for dental assistants builds on the firm's core strength in customer service, has a dedicated web page that signals it is valued, and strengthens customer retention at modest cost, so there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
